Convert an epi_df to/from a "vstretched, numeric" form

Source: R/vstretched_numeric_formats.R
to_vstretched_numeric_edf_info.Rd

Analogue of to_vstretched_numeric_archive_info for epi_dfs: to_vstretched_numeric_edf_info converts an epi_df x to (i) an epi_df with integer time_type and bare numeric time_values, plus (ii) conversion metadata, with (i) and (ii) packed in a named list. from_vstretched_numeric_edf_info converts from this format back to the format of x.

Usage

to_vstretched_numeric_edf_info(x)

from_vstretched_numeric_edf_info(transformed_x, conversion)

Arguments

x

an epi_df

transformed_x

an epi_df with time_type "integer" and bare numeric time_values, in the converted form described by conversion; e.g., to_vstretched_numeric_edf_info(x)$edf or some processed version of it.

conversion

the conversion element of the to_vstretched_numeric_edf_info output.

Value

  • Of to_vstretched_numeric_edf_info: a list with elements:

    • edf: the converted epi_df, with time_type "integer".

    • conversion: a list with elements time_type (x's time_type) and torigin, to pass to from_vstretched_numeric_edf_info or use when converting other time values.

  • Of from_vstretched_numeric_edf_info: transformed_x with time_type and time_value representations converted back to those of the original epi_df.

Details

time_values are converted with time_values_to_torigin_offsets; other time values (e.g., function arguments) can be converted consistently by forwarding conversion$torigin and conversion$time_type to it, and back with torigin_offsets_to_time_values. epi_dfs have no version column, and as_of is left unchanged (it's not converted to the stretched scale), so verbs shouldn't relate it to the converted time_values.

Grouping is preserved, but x must not be grouped by time_value.

Verbs that change the number of rows from zero to nonzero are incompatible with the "from" transformation.
